pages.text: Every kill feeds the $(l)souls$() counter on screen: a little for small fry, five for most things, forty for the elite, a hundred and fifty for lords and bosses. That's coin: spend it with the $(l)Merchant$() and $(l)Blacksmith$() in Firelink.

Your $(l)experience$() is the other kind of soul, the kind that makes you stronger: spend it at a bonfire to level up. Die and it waits on your corpse.$(br2)$(l)Lord Souls$() are something else again: items carried by great beasts, used to forge legendary weapons.
